tools.name: quoapi.search
tools.description: Find canonical QuoAPI capability handles by intent, ID or provider; catalog metadata are not upstream API results. Use query="*" to enumerate MCP-visible capabilities (limit 1–20; offset 0 then next_offset until null). Inventory returns total/count/next_offset; keyword search returns up to limit mat

tools.name: quoapi.describe
tools.description: Read the DESIGN-TIME contract for an exact handle from quoapi.search (e.g. address.validate): inputSchema/outputSchema, auth/scopes, pricing, availability, regions and REST mapping. Use inputSchema before quoapi.execute. No upstream action or charges are performed; this does not test credentials or

tools.name: quoapi.execute
tools.description: Execute an authorized handle using the inputSchema from quoapi.describe. May send messages, modify/delete data or incur charges: check pricing and obtain user approval first. For live actions, confirm=true, interactive confirmation or step-up may be required; policy can still deny execution. Optiona

tools.name: quoapi.inspect
tools.description: Read-only RUNTIME STATUS of the QuoAPI MCP gateway, not a provider execution. With no arguments returns state, server protocol version, tool count, visible capability count and discovery/registry revisions. Optional capability handle adds public context only: this is not to test upstream execution,

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: quoapi.execute · Private data: quoapi.describe, quoapi.execute, quoapi.inspect · Public sink: quoapi.execute · Destructive: quoapi.describe, quoapi.execute, quoapi.inspect.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: quoapi.execute · Private data: quoapi.describe, quoapi.execute, quoapi.inspect · Public sink: quoapi.execute · Destructive: quoapi.describe, quoapi.execute, quoapi.inspect

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
